prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with shoulder injury after a side impact at intersection. The patient had 21 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1217; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment followed a usual course and tapered off as the patient improved.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a side-impact collision at an intersection, reporting pain and limited motion in the right shoulder. The mechanism of injury is consistent with the reported symptoms and the force involved in the crash. Over a course of 21 visits, care proceeded along a typical rehabilitation pathway, including physical therapy, range-of-motion exercises, and targeted strengthening, with visit frequency decreasing as functional gains were achieved. Examination revealed findings that support a shoulder soft-tissue injury, including pain with resisted movement and reduced range in certain planes, while other orthopedic and neurological tests returned within normal limits. The patient reports no prior injury or treatment involving this shoulder. Billing records reflect each service once, without duplicate or repeated charges. Current status shows meaningful improvement, and the patient is being discharged to a home exercise program with follow-up as needed.
